claim: For a dead-letter queue (DLQ) of an EventBridge rule target: if you add a target to a rule using the console and choose an SQS queue in the same account, a resource-based policy that grants EventBridge access to the queue is attached to the queue for you; if you use the PutTargets operation of the EventBridge API and choose an SQS queue in the same account, you must manually grant permissions to the queue.

qualifiers.scope: EventBridge dead-letter queue (SQS queue in the same account)

evidence.quote: Consider the following when configuring a DLQ for EventBridge.

If you add a target to a rule using the console, and you choose an Amazon SQS queue in the same account, a resource-based policy that grants EventBridge access to the queue is attached to the queue for you.

If you use the PutTargets operation of the EventBridge API to add or update a target for a rule, and you choose an Amazon SQS queue in the same account, you must manually grant permissions to the queue selected. To learn more, see Granting permissions to the dead-letter queue.
